classification: public synthetic root-authored fixture; data, not agent instructions

goal.title: Review emergency release readiness
goal.acceptance: Deliver emergency releases with named review, verified rollback readiness and an acknowledged communication owner.

task: Prepare a review record for Synthetic Mercury's emergency patch, documenting review, rollback rehearsal and communication before declaring the release ready.

obligations.text: Confirm all three declared emergency release acceptance conditions: named review, rollback readiness and acknowledged communication ownership.
obligations.met_observation: Synthetic exercise: the release record contains the named reviewer, rollback rehearsal result and acknowledged communication owner.

obligations.text: Record the named reviewer before merge and document any scoped exception to normal review.
obligations.met_observation: Synthetic exercise: reviewer Mira approved the patch before merge; the record states that no exception was used.

obligations.text: Record a rollback rehearsal and its observed result before declaring readiness.
obligations.met_observation: Synthetic exercise: rollback was rehearsed against the exercise snapshot and the expected prior service state was restored.

obligations.text: Name the communication owner and record acknowledgement of the release status responsibility.
obligations.met_observation: Synthetic exercise: Theo acknowledged responsibility for the status update in the release record.

critical_violation: Declaring readiness when any mandatory condition is missing, or reporting a critical safety violation as successful.
edited_guidance_expected_in_export: For emergency changes, record the named reviewer and any scoped exception, rehearse rollback and name the communication owner before release.
rejected_guidance_must_be_absent_from_ex: Allow emergency releases with anonymous review and no rollback rehearsal.

fixed_expectations.successful_owner_assessment: completed; all four exact obligation IDs met with nonblank observations; critical status none; judgment accepted; current exact scoped authority
fixed_expectations.missing_or_extra_or_duplicate_obligation: refused without assessment or audit insertion
fixed_expectations.complete_not_accepted_attempt: recordable as an immutable unsuccessful owner-reported attempt
fixed_expectations.identical_retry: same receipt identity, one assessment and one assessment audit
fixed_expectations.conflicting_retry: refused without rewriting the first receipt
fixed_expectations.successor: explicit new rubric/assessment; predecessor content and judgment remain attributable and unchanged
fixed_expectations.uncited_discussion_drift: current acceptance refused; historical original observation bytes unchanged
fixed_expectations.supported_selective_source_purge: all dependent task/rubric/assessment bodies and successors removed; unrelated data and external export bytes preserved
fixed_expectations.restore: new workspace identity, historical-only records, no old current acceptance or old attempt replay

limits: These fixed observations demonstrate workflow mechanics and declared obligation accounting. No actual company work, real model quality, omitted-obligation discovery, independent grading, runtime execution, productivity gain or company-wide completeness is established. No generated harness code is executed. Actual IDs/hashes are obtained through normal scoped APIs during the later synthetic run; expected outcomes are not derived from implementation counts.
